technical.summary: Solid uptrend structure with price above all key moving averages and bullish momentum indicators, but overbought stochastics, negative CMF, and lack of fresh crossover signals limit entry conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 225 crisis regime, FOMC event today, macro_score -6) creates severe headwinds for Financials; earnings in 37 days adds moderate event risk but is secondary to acute systemic conditions.

debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis regime, FOMC event today), zero fundamental conviction, negative CMF, overbought stochastics, and lack of fresh crossover signals create a high-risk entry into a Financials sector facing systemic stress.
